verdict.recommendation: REJECT consecutive holds and the 60 percent count. Seconds above 12.155 and 8.285 do not accumulate through an advertisement. The mean score still sits higher in ads than in ordinary football, so the next measurement is a rolling mean with a cutoff frozen on the NBC games. Do not train a new model, and do not add another timer on these two lines.

labels: These Prime ledgers mark ad breaks only. Music, promos, halftime, and announcer turns are not labeled. ordinary_program is more than 60 seconds from every break. return_transition is the 15 seconds after a break. commercial_edge is the first and last 15 seconds of a break.
